note: Original sample questions written for FreeStudentKit. They are not past questions.

sets.title: Use of English: sample practice
sets.blurb: Grammar, vocabulary and spelling. A short warm-up, not a past paper.

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Each of the students have submitted a form.
Each of the students has submitted a form.
Each of the students are submitting a form.
Each of the student has submit a form.
questions.explanation: “Each” is singular, so it takes the singular verb “has”, and “students” is plural after “of”.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to “benevolent”.
questions.explanation: Benevolent means well-meaning and kind.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to “scarce”.
questions.explanation: Scarce means in short supply. The opposite is plentiful, or abundant.

questions.q: She has been living in Benin ___ 2019.
questions.explanation: “Since” is used with a point in time. “For” is used with a length of time (for five years).

questions.q: The police ___ investigating the case.
questions.explanation: “Police” is a plural noun and takes a plural verb.

questions.q: Choose the correct spelling.
questions.explanation: Accommodation has double c and double m.

questions.q: If I ___ you, I would apologise.
questions.explanation: In a formal “if” sentence about something unreal, standard English uses “were” for every subject.

questions.q: What is the plural of “phenomenon”?
questions.explanation: Phenomenon comes from Greek and its plural is phenomena.

questions.q: He is very good ___ mathematics.
questions.explanation: We say “good at” a subject or skill.

questions.q: The news of the strike was ___.
questions.explanation: “Shocking” describes the news. “Shocked” describes how a person feels.

questions.q: Which of these is a complete sentence?
questions.explanation: The other options begin with a linking word and leave the idea unfinished, so they need a main clause.

questions.q: Choose the correct passive form of “The student wrote the report.”
options: The report is wrote by the student.
The report has wrote the student.
The report was written by the student.
The student was written by the report.
questions.explanation: The passive uses a form of “be” plus the past participle (written).

questions.q: The company has changed ___ policy.
questions.explanation: “Its” shows ownership. “It's” means “it is” or “it has”.

questions.q: By next July, she ___ her degree.
questions.explanation: The future perfect (will have + past participle) describes something finished before a future time.

questions.q: The word “punctual” means ___.
questions.explanation: Punctual means on time.

sets.title: Computer basics: sample practice
sets.blurb: Hardware, software, safety and the internet, at GST level.

questions.q: What does CPU stand for?
questions.explanation: The CPU is the part that carries out instructions.

questions.q: Which of these is an input device?
questions.explanation: Input devices send data into the computer. Monitors, printers and speakers send data out.

questions.q: How many bits are in one byte?
questions.explanation: One byte is eight bits.

questions.q: RAM is described as volatile memory because ___.
options: it is only used for storage
its contents are lost when the power is off
it is slower than a hard disk
questions.explanation: RAM holds data the computer is using now and is cleared when power is lost.

questions.q: Which of these is an operating system?
questions.explanation: Android runs the phone. The others are applications that run on an operating system.

questions.q: A file ending in .pdf is a ___.
questions.explanation: PDF files keep their layout on different devices.

questions.q: In Windows, which keys copy the selected text?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+C copies, Ctrl+V pastes, Ctrl+X cuts and Ctrl+Z undoes.

questions.q: Phishing is ___.
options: a way of speeding up the internet
tricking people with fake messages to get their private details
a program that cleans a computer
questions.explanation: Never share a password, PIN or OTP because of a message or call you did not expect.

questions.q: What does URL stand for?
questions.explanation: A URL is a web address.

questions.q: Which of these is the strongest password?
questions.explanation: Strong passwords are long, mix characters, and do not use names, dates or common words.

questions.q: A computer virus is ___.
options: a harmful program that can copy itself and damage files
questions.explanation: Viruses spread through unsafe files and links.

questions.q: Which program is a spreadsheet application?
questions.explanation: Excel works with rows, columns and formulas.

questions.q: HTML is mainly used to ___.
options: structure the content of web pages
questions.explanation: HTML describes headings, paragraphs, links and images on a page.

questions.q: Which of these is an example of cloud storage?
options: A hard disk in a laptop
questions.explanation: Cloud storage keeps your files on servers you reach over the internet.

questions.q: Wi-Fi allows a device to ___.
options: connect to a network without cables
questions.explanation: Wi-Fi is a wireless way to connect to a local network.

sets.title: Numeracy: sample practice
sets.blurb: Percentages, fractions, ratios, averages and simple equations.

questions.q: What is 15% of ₦8,000?
Simplify 3/4 + 1/8.
Solve for x: 2x + 5 = 17.
After a 10% discount a shirt costs ₦4,500. What was the original price?
questions.explanation: The discounted price is 90% of the original: 4,500 ÷ 0.9 = 5,000.

questions.q: Find the mean of 12, 15, 18 and 25.
questions.explanation: The sum is 70, and 70 ÷ 4 = 17.5.

questions.q: What is the simple interest on ₦50,000 at 8% a year for 3 years?
₦24,000 is shared in the ratio 3 : 5. What is the larger share?
questions.explanation: There are 8 parts. Each part is 3,000, so 5 parts = 15,000.

questions.q: What is the area of a rectangle 12 m long and 7.5 m wide?
questions.explanation: Area = length × width = 12 × 7.5 = 90.

questions.q: Find the value of √144 + 5².
questions.explanation: √144 = 12 and 5² = 25, so the total is 37.

questions.q: Write 0.375 as a fraction in its simplest form.
questions.explanation: 0.375 = 375/1000, which simplifies to 3/8.

questions.q: A car covers 180 km in 2.5 hours. What is its average speed?
questions.explanation: Speed = distance ÷ time = 180 ÷ 2.5 = 72.

questions.q: Simplify 2⁵ ÷ 2².
questions.explanation: Subtract the powers: 2^(5−2) = 2³ = 8.

questions.q: By what percentage does a number increase when it goes from 40 to 50?
questions.explanation: Increase = 10, and 10 ÷ 40 = 0.25, which is 25%.

questions.q: Find the median of 3, 9, 4, 7, 1.
questions.explanation: In order: 1, 3, 4, 7, 9. The middle value is 4.

questions.q: Three pens cost ₦450. How much do seven pens cost?
questions.explanation: One pen costs 150, so seven pens cost 1,050.

sets.title: Human biology basics: sample practice
sets.blurb: Foundation facts for health science students. Not a replacement for your course notes.

questions.q: How many chambers does the human heart have?
questions.explanation: Two atria and two ventricles.

questions.q: Which pigment in red blood cells carries oxygen?
questions.explanation: Haemoglobin binds oxygen in the lungs and releases it in the tissues.

questions.q: Which organ produces insulin?
questions.explanation: Beta cells in the pancreas make insulin, which lowers blood glucose.

questions.q: Which blood group is the universal donor for red blood cells?
questions.explanation: O negative red cells lack A, B and Rh antigens, so they can be given in emergencies.

questions.q: How many bones are in an adult human body?
questions.explanation: Babies are born with more bones, and several fuse as they grow.

questions.q: What is the basic functional unit of the nervous system?
questions.explanation: Neurons carry signals as electrical and chemical messages.

questions.q: Where does most nutrient absorption take place?
questions.explanation: The small intestine has villi that give a very large absorbing surface.

questions.q: What is the main role of white blood cells?
questions.explanation: White blood cells are part of the immune system.

questions.q: What is the largest organ of the human body?
questions.explanation: The skin covers the whole body and protects it.

questions.q: Where does gas exchange between air and blood happen?
questions.explanation: Oxygen moves into the blood and carbon dioxide moves out across the alveolar walls.

questions.q: Which vitamin can the body make in the skin with sunlight?
questions.explanation: Skin makes vitamin D when exposed to ultraviolet B light.

questions.q: What is a normal resting heart rate for a healthy adult?
questions.explanation: Fit people can be lower than 60, but 60 to 100 is the usual adult range.

questions.q: Which organ filters the blood and makes urine?
questions.explanation: Each kidney has about a million nephrons.

questions.q: Genetic information is stored in ___.
questions.explanation: DNA carries the instructions for building proteins.

questions.q: Malaria is caused by ___.
questions.explanation: Plasmodium is spread by the bite of infected female Anopheles mosquitoes.
